user_story: As a user, I want to fill out the text box form on the demoqa website so that I can submit my personal information and see it displayed correctly. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The user must be able to enter their full name in the input field with id 'userName'. 2. The user must be able to enter their email address in the input field with id 'userEmail'. 3. The user can enter their current address in the textarea with id 'currentAddress'. 4. The user can enter their permanent address in the textarea with id 'permanentAddress'. 5. Upon clicking the button with id 'submit', the form data must be displayed correctly. 6. If the form is submitted without entering any data, the URL must remain the same.
